reviews.text: 感谢婵婵姐赠送的CD Key。最低难度，动物全解锁。这个游戏刚发商店页面我就加入愿望单了，中世纪手绘画风，着实让我这个中世纪迷上头不已。各种蠢萌的动物伙伴，还有诸如漏屁股放屁之类的恶搞技能，让游戏在中世纪严肃的画风下，潜藏着的却是掩饰不住的逗逼风格！游戏的策略性还是有的，不过与其说是JRPG的那种回合制战斗，本游戏更像是个“解谜”游戏，有时候就是要按照一定的攻击次序才能最安全地过关，这让游玩体验并不那么爽快。另外，在按Q开启提示详情后，字体和UI布局还是稍显局促，可以优化。 说起来，小时候经常和同学在纸上画各种小人打架，Inkulinati算是实现了儿时“纸上谈兵”的梦想。[b]评价：7.5/10[/b]（有乐趣，但也有提升空间） 关注阿朝，一起来玩游戏！
What a disappointment.

The game is not bad, it has an interesting and unique art style and some nice ideas on the gameplay, which is basically a "2D XCOM", and this would be definetly earn a positive review, if the game didnt cost as much as it does, which is waaaaaay overvaluing itself, for how the game currently is, its worth at least only half of what is being charged. Because in the end its yet another roguelike with a different twist on the genre, and we already have tons of that, besides, the SFX and music are simply lacking that "oomph" to make the turn-based gameplay exciting, and once I got past the novelty of the artstyle, i realized how the artstyle actually makes the game look robotic and clumsy, at least on the characters. Also, if you are going to play it, first and best thing you do is turn fast mode on, without that the game is unbearable to play of how slow everything is, and fast mode makes it look "normal" I will wait for the 2 weeks time that i am allowed to have before refunding if the game actually updates to something that makes it worth as much as what the devs are asking, but i highly doubt that, considering their roadmap

目前先好评，平面战棋类游戏本来就少，这一部凭借出色的美术风格还是很出彩的，但是鉴于目前是抢先体验，还是得观望后续发展，多人联机建议搞起来这样才有游戏粘性，还有就是丰富游戏内容，不然真对不起这个价格 玩了一会回来吐槽一下第二章第一战，是哪个天才想出来的？一开局就给你摆好位置，彳亍，然后呢？位置位置不让人改？那你那个对局设置设置了个鸡巴？嗯？对面有20血的装甲狗就算了，人家标标准准的站位，好吗我这边日妈弓和奶顶在前面刀和矛全在最后而且一路连个格子都没有走都走不动，一点难度过渡都没有？直接上来就这样？而且过关给的奖励都随机而且几选一，意思有可能因为选的垃圾结果死档？压根过不去？反正大家自己体会一下吧，我觉得这种不论你兵种选择给你事先摆好阵势的关卡真的就是屑
我玩了两遍教程 打到第二关boss 我的兵永远在睡觉 是个好游戏 让我深刻了解到自己确实是个笨逼 【有没有公正之人来评判一下呜呜呜】
好游戏，但以内容来说价格太高，且是抢先体验，生生突出了一个抢字。
All style, no substance. I like the aesthetics, but I found the gameplay boring and the unlocks uninteresting.

不推荐，虽然玩法和画风是有不少新意，但价格太高，目前内容太少，而且玩起来非常不爽，特别是敌人强度和行动非常恶心人，没有半点平衡性，那个恶魔和骷髅系根本压着你打，虽然有所谓的异端克制伤害，但是主教又贵又少走的又慢，战斗力和恶魔骷髅系敌人根本不成正比。那几个boss墨法师一出场就站在绝对有利的地形，很多对你秒杀的特效对敌人居然无效，百分百的就是不公平，敌人还经常会用一些恶心的招式堵路推人，AOE满场乱放，导致你走位根本没有用。而且因为是轮流行动所以，有些战斗一开始就是被包围，你动完了敌人马上就动，你拿对方根本没有办法，整个游戏关卡和敌人是建立在一种不公平的机制下，导致玩得很憋屈，就是那种专门设好陷阱等你来踩的，你明知道是陷阱又不得不踩恶心感觉。

No for now but read below -Nice art but always in the same brownish tone. -Lost of units, but you really only need 3 types. -Nice music but always repeating the same 2 songs -A lot of strategics depth, but you can find a formula that works everytime. -Strategy game but too many random events that will pull the carpet from under you. -Store to buy upgrades and units, but often useless since you've unlock units by playing. -Quills will allows you to pass a boss without winning against it. -A very different type of game, but Too many things to learn at the beginning you need to play one campaign at easy to wrap your head around everything.

为美术风格买的。希望能添加捏人之类的玩法，塑造自己的中世纪角色。 我不是左撇子，希望能自由选择左右撇子。 既然是中世纪，比起金属笔尖，更希望是羽毛笔。 明明角色的造型是在书写书籍，但角色造型里体现的东西在游戏里并没有。如刮羊皮纸的刀，放置书籍的倾斜的书写台。 从选人界面看四个角色感觉只是造型和台词差异，希望能出现能力差异。 其他希望体现到游戏里的部分：与羽毛笔配套的墨水瓶没看见，压书的文镇也没有看到。文字本身的墨水的确是黑的，但玩家操纵的是插画，墨水应该是彩色才对。中世纪手抄本的插画往往也会用黄金涂色，作为贵重物品，黄金似乎应该与普通墨水不同。 游戏不好玩，战斗过程冗长，类ROUGE的跑图加剧了这种枯燥，玩法单一。目前的半成品不值这个价钱，看到支持者包DLC里说未来会提供美术设计和中世纪参考资料，对我这种冲着美术风格来的人来说，反而是支持者DLC可以稍微贵一些。

高难度下的无聊值（使用兵种会永久增加该兵种的费用，一场战斗如果不使用该兵种会缓慢复原费用）简直毁了游戏体验，在没有减无聊的事件前我构筑的体系兵根本不敢上场，那让我构筑的意义何在？一个轻度肉鸽的战旗策略游戏，高难度下一半的时间你都不能使用你构筑的兵，你必须要用你临时搜刮来的各种其它体系的兵种来应付战斗（它们费用叠高了你可以直接扔，低费兵费用能轻易翻个倍等它自然恢复和事件减无聊减下来还不如直接丢了），高难度最难的不是敌人资源远超你也不是敌人占据优势地形，而是玩家因为这个傻逼无聊值而搞得畏手畏脚，石头剪刀布对面出布你却因为怕以后剪刀费用太高只能无奈打出石头，把剪刀小心的揣着珍藏起来想着关键时刻再用，蠢不蠢

It pains me to leave a negative review for Inkulinati, because it's a genuinely charming game and the tactical battles have much to recommend them - the importance of movement and positioning of units is critical to success, and it's very easy to set up quick wins or suffer unexpected defeats because of your skill as positioning, or lack thereof. However, the game suffers tremendously from a campaign structure that works at odds with its battle system. The point of a branching campaign structure is to force the player to make difficult and interesting decisions to increase the power of his build to be able to better fight increasingly difficult opponents, but this simply does not hold true in Inkulinati. You're offered upgrades to your avatar on the battlefield, and can swap out the units you choose to draw, but enough units are similar enough to one another that they don't feel like upgrades but rather different tools in your arsenal, so there's no sense of progression on the campaign map. Further, later combats aren't significantly more difficult than earlier ones because the emphasis on positioning makes it possible for players to win battles with inferior armies - and "superior" units cost significantly more ink to draw than "inferior" ones, meaning it's often better to just use cheaper, worse units anyways. This creates a sort of fatigue playing through a campaign, where it feels like you're just going through the motions of a campaign structure because the developers believe it to be obligatory to hold the game together, when it does not meaningfully improve the experience. And as the player, I'm forced to go through these campaigns multiple times because in order to unlock new units with different abilities, I have to beat the campaign repeatedly. My experience with the game has been "picking up the game, playing a few battles, realizing that none of the decisions made on the campaign map actually matter all that much, and putting it down." Inkulinati has the potential to be a fantastic tactical puzzle game, but until these issues with the campaign structure are resolved in some way I cannot recommend it.

冲着美术风格买的。但是我不推荐买。 一句话总结，就是有意思但是不好玩。 是roguelite，但又不是传统rouge。一般来说如果是一般rouge，多次的重开，盘外加强就可以尝试不同流派（兵种），从被npc暴打到暴打npc，之后再手动调整难度，优化流派。但是这游戏途中获取的能力和兵种（卡牌）固定，后续没有提升，兵种之前没有强联动（弱的也没有）而游戏每次下本是有几条命的，换句话说，开发者是希望每把都认真推进，这样就没有盘外招了，每次进战斗有点像下象棋，围棋的感觉，要想玩好就必须每一步都仔细思考，否则走错一步就很容易无力回天需要重开，导致玩的不爽。 进第三个大地图时，怪物可以给我上颠舞，我没有任何反制方法，因为前面没有拿到奇迹治疗的技能，最起码搞个2-3回合负面状态消失吧，没有，看着怪活生生给我A死，给我搞笑出来了。

这是一款横屏回合制策略游戏，玩家将扮演一位绘制和操控墨兽的墨法师，通过自行搭配墨兽、亲手动作与技艺来挑战一个又一个关卡。 在游戏内容方面，这款游戏在教学部分投入了较大的精力，全部教学关卡加在一起有着差不多两小时的流程，这些关卡对游戏的基本操作与各类特殊的墨兽有着较为详细的介绍和上手体验，可以帮助玩家更好的上手游戏（当然，如果玩家觉得这些教程过长的话，即便只通关修女的初学者课程也是足够了的）。在游戏的正篇部分，该作在设计上沿用了同类型游戏的爬塔式分支线路选择，这些选择包含了战斗、商店、随机事件等内容。在战斗方面，该作的战斗包含了两种形式，一种是玩家（有时还有电脑的）操作的墨法师角色在场，通过消耗墨水来绘制各式各样的墨兽，并结合自身的亲手动作（墨法师的主动技能）与技艺（被动技能）来击败敌人，且无论是哪一方的墨法师死亡都会直接判定其对局失败；而另一种战斗则是墨法师不在场的情况，这种模式下玩家只能操作场上仅有的墨兽进行战斗，玩起来有点像是棋牌游戏中的残局解谜，需要玩家合理规划墨兽的行动，通过场景中的物品结合地形杀来打出优势。 在游戏的体验方面，这款游戏在手绘美术与语音方面表现优秀，结合真人播片的形式也为游戏增添了不少乐趣，但目前来看我个人感觉该作还是存在一些问题的，比如游戏中同阵容之间的兵种在配合上大多缺少连协性（除了死神的骷髅兵），这在很大程度上是由于游戏中的无聊值设定所导致的（在一场游戏中，如果玩家多次绘制同一种墨兽，那么下次战斗时绘制它所需的墨水费用便会增多，需要隔一场战斗或触发相关事件后才能恢复），在部分阵营之间也存在着几乎完全相同的职业位置（比如兔子狐狸和狗这三个阵营，虽然各单位之间在面板和主动技能上有所区别，但他们都有着剑兵、矛兵、弓箭手这些基础单位），在我看来，这虽然像是一种鼓励玩家拿不同阵营的墨兽在每场战斗间进行轮换的机制，但在很大程度上也限制了玩家的选择与自由发挥的空间（因为玩家的墨兽库存是有限的，在功能上比较相似且用于战斗轮换的基础墨兽单位通常需要额外占据我2-3个库存空间，而具备特殊能力的更为强力的墨兽在绘制时需要花费较多的墨水，玩家开局时的墨水也很有限，如果只带高费墨兽上场的话存在翻车的风险，在性价比和墨水产出上这些高费墨兽也不如基础单位），希望制作组在今后的更新中对无聊值的机制和相同阵容之间的墨兽加成进行改进（比如增加玩家可携带的墨兽最大值，增添可减少无聊值增长的技艺，加强同阵容中同时上场的墨兽的能力等），进一步丰富玩家的游戏体验。 综合来看，这款游戏虽然目前还处于抢先体验阶段，但基本已经做到五脏俱全，在美术和配乐上表现优秀。在游戏内容上，除了具备拥有各式各样能力的墨兽外，墨法师角色的亲手动作和技艺也为游戏增添了不少的乐趣与变数，通过结合场景道具和地形能够打出各种意想不到的效果，推荐对回合制策略游戏感兴趣的玩家尝试一下，值得一玩。 [code]欢迎参观我的： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33217084]真实评测[/url] 喜欢这篇评论，也麻烦点个赞，让更多人能够看到。[/code]

价格偏高。好玩的同时也不好玩。 - 可买：吃这个美术风格，同时喜欢传统棋类游戏（跳棋，象棋，围棋等），喜欢数学向解谜游戏（华容道，接水管等）的玩家。 - 别买：想要玩的是主流卡牌策略游戏，想要肉鸽外循环，喜欢研究配牌组和联动，讨厌解谜和复杂计算的玩家。 ---------------------------------------------- 这游戏好玩在于需要你动脑子做计算， 不好玩在只能动脑子做计算不能在熟悉了几局后靠叠流派叠buff爽推，这对于任何和打牌沾边的游戏都是很败好感的。 没有阵营联动加成，每一局战斗都像是在公园解骗钱老头子摆的残局，越往后玩脑细胞损耗越大，和传统卡牌越到后面越爽完全是反的。 买之前以为会是邪恶铭刻那种牌组干净简单但组合多样的脑内高潮爽局， 完了以后发现是机制极其复杂牌组过多毫无联动buff的算数解谜类游戏。 不过我是奔着美术风格买的所以还是满意的，可以看出设计者花了非常多的时间设计这么多繁复到我看都懒得看的敌人和地图机制...教程玩完都得俩小时，你怎么能对着这样的开发者说不好的话呢？ 推荐。

I love the art style and whimsical, humorous nature of the game. There are a ton of summon-able units and varied mechanics that allow you to tackle battles in a number of ways. I just didn't find it fun and at no point did it feel like more than a slog.
不好玩

The idea is nice, but the game seems just way too overcomplicated to play even in the tutorial. Animations are so slow, most of the time I have to wait for the results, new round or whatever - but this can be partially solved by using the fast mode. . Rewind of the last step in tutorial would make it easier and faster to play/learn. I like the style of the game - 5/5, but the gameplay is really exhausting instead of being enjoyable - 2/5. I do hope they will improve the game before the actual release, but given they are almost on the release date, probably this won't happen. Maybe they will improve the game afterwards at least?

Playing this game immediately turned me off. Is it too slow? Is it too silly? Is it too boring? I don't think it's any one problem, but a host of small annoyances that make it drag to play. I honestly don't know if I'll ever go back to reappraise it. Edit: I came back years later to try again. Just getting through the tutorial is an immediate snoozefest. I just can't.

The game is very quaint and interesting. However, one thing makes this review negative: the game punishes you for not reading, then punishes (or I suppose fails to reward) you for reading. The glossary rules are not organised in the same way as the tutorial pages (the latter are oftentimes split between the former or missing). The game is missing some user friendly popups (including in the tutorial menu if you are trying to dig out a rule you have to go off pictures only). A whole bunch of the popups are wrong; the same terminology can mean many different things. It is often lacks specificity; 1 ability will say it affects "x" whereas it actually affects "xy" and other times it says "xy" and instead affects "xyz". And finally, it is just clunky to try and read things in the first place when it comes to what you can read and when. It almost feels as if the people in charge of ability balance and the people in charge of UI haven't been talking. Like at one point it was accurate but as each unit has just had its own deviations from the baseline it hasn't been reflected in the description whether because of lag or nuance that cannot be conveyed in the old format. Much of what happens is blatantly unexplained. At no point does it ever feel like I am having a fun time making meaningful decisions because anything can happen no matter what the game says can happen - and I have lost all motivation to play further. Minor gripe: there was no more neat voice work like I thought there might be from the trailer. I'll change this review when they fix these up - it is early days. I recommend keeping an eye on this game - or buying on launch sale and then waiting a bit to fire up.
夸夸！很好玩的平面回合制游戏 美术也很喜欢 就是高难模式是真困难 多牌组之间 随着关卡深入 领取奖励后可以根据个人习惯有多种组合 搭配技能给关卡提供了非常多的解法
这游戏所有教程关伤害都是随机的 教程教我操作完秒杀敌人 结果直接给我roll个1点伤害 真的很难绷 我还以为自己操作错了 这游戏美术还可以 但是游戏性真的是灾难
冲着中世纪tag去的，有点失望，除了画风之外基本和中世纪没有任何关系，感觉是随便哪个回合制算点战旗肉鸽换皮，你哪怕画个圣母玛利亚打恶魔（文艺复兴之前真的有蛮多魁梧玛利亚）我也算你跟中世纪文化有点关系了……
想当初这游戏定价一百多，高定价劝退了一部分人，最后拗不过玩家降价了。结果现在直接进包了，1块9拿下，当个小游戏玩玩还是很不错的。

《Inkulinati》一款很棒的游戏，具有非常有趣的玩法和极具魅力的艺术方向。在将主题、机制和表现力结合方面令人印象深刻。由墨水驱动的战斗既刺激又紧张，奖励实验性玩法以及良好的手势和技能运用。游戏的世界受中世纪手稿边缘插图的启发，既美丽又具有沉浸感。单人剧情模式非常强大，但与其他玩家对战，尤其是在本地多人模式下，乐趣更大，特别是当双方玩家在与电脑对战时学到了一些技巧。 《Inkulinati》在视觉上非常富有创意，且战斗机制引人入胜。 最搞笑的是，这游戏当初定价100+和抢鲜体验阶段，劝退了一部分人，最后官方拗不过玩家降价了。结果现在直接进HB2024.12月包了，≤2￥买下，当个小游戏玩玩还是很不错的。

The art style is unique, but unfortunately, that's about it for this game. The game mechanics are not very deep, and the gameplay becomes repetitive, where choices do not really matter and some units are clearly better than others once you learn to push or devour another unit. Once I beat the main game once, I did not feel motivated to do it another time, let alone a 3rd time, just to unlock the "true ending", because the main gameplay simply wasn't very satisfying or rewarding to play. In a proper strategy game, the mechanics must be deep enough where a player can feel "smart" or rewarded for figuring out their own style of play (but isn't forced to play a certain way), but if a strategy game doesn't achieve that then it's not a strategy game but rather a puzzle game where you figure out where things go in order to "win" and once you've done that there's no reason to play further.

Obviously, half of the appeal is in the style; who wouldn't be charmed by the prospect of fighting Death with an army of little guys, all drawn in the style of medieval marginalia? Beyond that, though, it is a competent wargame. The tutorial is pretty good, teaching you how to do all the stuff you need to know to win a fight, and a little beyond that. There are also some side puzzles that are actually kinda difficult, if you want the advanced training. You get a broad roster to play with, starting with foxes, dogs and rabbits, and with progress you can unlock monkeys, two kinds of little guys, fish, devils, and more. You can also just mix and match over the course of a campaign, picking up new guys after some battles. Fight Death with two devils, a snail that can just eat folks, a guy who explodes, and a monkey chucking stuff around. You've got your status effects and terrain, which can also be created or destroyed by the player or their troops. Devils can create fire sparks, skeletons can infect people with the plague, rabbits and donkeys can moon people to prevent them from moving and fighting next turn. You've got some interesting synergies with the talents and roster. The one that carried me through my last playthrough was the combination of skeletons infecting people and getting a drop of ink for every infected fighter on the field, meaning I was always swimming in the ink I needed to draw characters. You've got a limited retries system; if you can't beat a fight on your first try, you can sacrifice a quill to try it again. You only get a few quills, though, so git gud. My big complaint is that it can feel kinda samey, the way roguelikes often do. The choices are just "which number do you want to go up", the fights are always "run for the other guy's tiny". I'm willing to forgive that, though, because the fights, as much as they resemble each other, are fun. I am still extremely charmed by the prospect of fighting Death with an army of little guys.

Inkulinati definitely grabs you with the medieval margin illustration theme... and credit where it's due, the illustrations are pretty good and the theme is a fun and welcome one. But the theme is skin deep here, once you move past that and see the actual game, this is just a weak ripoff of Slay the Spire only it costs a lot more. Designed for the Nintendo Switch and other consoles, this turn based battler has you summoning and placing various beasts, using a combination of their positions and abilities to beat the enemies on each "run". And if you decide to play this seriously you'll be repeating these runs a lot, because your progress is locked behind mindlessly repeating the same shallow loop... and that's tiresome. I was very disappointed that despite all the work that went into art and theme here, the underlying game was so underwhelming. On the upside, the game does feature customisable controls and resolution, so at least some of the basic, minimum requirements have been met. Unfortunately there's a number of other technical defects and shortcomings which contribute to the game being difficult to recommend to gamers. Because this is designed for handheld/portable gaming appliances, it carries a number of deliberate design deficiencies. Compromises were made to cater to the low power handheld gaming appliances that the game was designed for. These are unfortunate compromises and limitations that PC gamers shouldn't be forced to accept, but it's evident that PC was a second thought for the mobile game developers. The game is deficient as a result of these choices, and would have been so much better without the handicaps that designing games for low power handhelds forces upon a game. While this might run well on a Steam Deck, we must remember the vast majority of gamers here are gaming on PC. The game features no proper level design or game/story flow/plot, as they opted to try to use samey repetitive procgen algorithms as a substitute for adding such content to the game, to avoid doing the important job of level/map design. As a result, the game doesn't actually have any content worth mentioning, just endless, boring, repetitive, soulless algorithmically generated sameyness. Developers must learn that procedural generation is not an acceptable substitute for content. These technical shortcomings push this game below minimum standards for any competently developed modern PC game. You're forced to sign a highly questionable yet legally unenforceable End User License Agreement... for such a relatively low effort, low quality game this comes across more as a delusion of grandeur than anything else. This agreement includes questionable requirements that may attempt to revoke consumer law protections that gamers expect to have, which is also highly problematic. Developers must learn they are here to serve gamers, not control them. I had my cat walk over the keyboard while the EULA was displaying, which fixed that problem for me. Let's talk about pricing and the actual value this has for gamers. Is this game one of the best of the 140,000+ games on Steam? Inkulinati has the greedy, cash grab price of $25 USD, for which you could easily get any number of older AAA games. There's additional $10 in cosmetic DLC available on top of the $25 USD purchase price. Selling cosmetics separately is the kind of thing that was invented for consoles and mobile phones, but here it is on Steam, too, the appalling microtransaction economy that gamers despise. It's not P2W, but I think it's important when developers are needlessly greedy. For comparison, the $25 asking price ($35 including all the DLC) for this game could get you games like "Mount and Blade 2 Bannerlord", "Elden Ring" or "Sekiro Shadows Die Twice". Quality, professionally made games like those are frequently on sale cheaper than this. Consider that eye-watering price, and that this whole thing could have been done in Adobe Flash, and you can reach the same conclusion I did pretty quickly. The quality problems and defects with this game makes the asking price totally unrealistic. It's impossible to recommend this to gamers here on Steam.
